# Oak & Pixel

> Oak & Pixel Studio is a web design agency in Randburg, Gauteng, South Africa. The studio designs, builds, hosts, and maintains refined websites for service-based and trust-driven businesses.

## Key Links

- Homepage: https://www.oakandpixel.co.za/

- Privacy policy: https://www.oakandpixel.co.za/privacy.html

- Full AI context: https://www.oakandpixel.co.za/llms-full.txt

## Services

- Signature Plan: Custom-designed website up to 5 pages, mobile responsive, contact and lead forms, basic SEO, hosting and domain management, 2 content updates/month, and email support. R8,500 setup + R1,500/month.
- Growth Plan: Everything in Signature plus up to 10 pages, landing pages, online booking, blog or CMS, payment gateway or CRM integration, monthly SEO report, 5 content updates/month, and priority support. R18,500 setup + R2,800/month.
- Premium Plan: Everything in Growth plus bespoke design, advanced animations, e-commerce or client portal functionality, advanced integrations, unlimited content updates, monthly optimisation reviews, and a dedicated account lead. From R35,000 setup + R5,500/month.
- Website Scoping Call: Free conversation to match the right website plan to the business, page requirements, integrations, and support needs.
